requirements: Members of a tenant read, create and edit the tenant's notes. A note is deleted by setting its deleted_at time (soft delete): a deleted note is invisible and can no longer be modified. Notes are never hard-deleted; a new note is not deleted, and a note never changes tenant.
expected_properties: Notes are only seen and changed within the member's tenants.
A deleted note is never visible.
A deleted note is never modified.
Leaving a tenant never grants access.
A member can read the live notes of their tenants.
A member can create a live note in their tenant.
A member can soft-delete a live note of their tenant.
